entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I have to say, the mood of this town is[n]definitely strange. I can't sense anyone[n]around.
Hey, guys. You lookin' for something?
Heh, I thought I heard someone rustlin'[n]around out here... and here y'all are.
Welcome to the desert, fellow trader.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm? What does he mean by "trader"?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We don't care about your welcomes.[n]You're a bandit, right? Just cough up[n]the thing you stole.
Ha! Well ain't this interestin'. A group[n]of criminals comin' after a fellow trader.
...Well, you're gonna have to catch me[n]if you want it.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wait! Ughhh, you just had to scare him[n]off, Skull!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We'll have time to talk later. Let's get[n]after him.
